request: DebugAI live repository and bounded container preflight after repaired common Host socket transport; read-only, no model execution

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
printf 'SERVERCORE_HOST_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_REALPATH='; realpath "$p"
printf 'DEBUGAI_HEAD='; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_BRANCH='; git -C "$p" branch --show-current
printf 'DEBUGAI_DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l
echo DEBUGAI_WORKTREE_LIST_BEGIN
git -C "$p" worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree / || /^HEAD / || /^branch /'
echo DEBUGAI_WORKTREE_LIST_END
printf 'PR115_SOURCE_LOCAL='; if git -C "$p" cat-file -e 'a20cb1a80d9fabaf6d9d23bbe77b9dc812d07705^{commit}' 2>/dev/null; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
echo DEBUGAI_CONTAINERS_BEGIN
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Image}}' | grep -Ei 'debug.?ai|ai.?core|sandbox' || true
echo DEBUGAI_CONTAINERS_END
